reporter.your_intention: Be in the Greyhound waiting area in Pittsburgh by ten. Find the bench in the back, the one under the fluorescent tube that buzzes. Sit. Close my eyes. Be awake at six. Gloves in my bag. Blankets rolled and in the trunk of the van I'll walk to at 7:02. Coffee money in my pocket. At her door at 7:15. She will be holding the spoon. I will say 'I got here.' That's the whole forecast. Nothing else is on the wire. The Rialto can keep its last reel. The ballroom can keep its lights. The driver can keep his flat.
